name: telegram
description: Telegram Bot API integration — send messages, photos, and documents from a bot, and read updates sent to it.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Telegram bot messaging via the Bot API

fields.label: Bot Token
fields.helpText: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token

tools.name: telegram.get_me
tools.description: Get basic information about the bot (verifies the token).

tools.name: telegram.send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a chat.

parseMode.description: How to parse entities in the message text

disableNotification.description: Send the message silently, without a notification

tools.name: telegram.send_photo
tools.description: Send a photo to a chat by URL.

photo.description: HTTP URL of the photo to send

tools.name: telegram.send_document
tools.description: Send a document/file to a chat by URL.

document.description: HTTP URL of the document to send

tools.name: telegram.get_updates
tools.description: Get recent messages and events sent to the bot.

offset.description: Identifier of the first update to return; use last update_id + 1 to confirm previous updates

limit.description: Max number of updates to return (default 100, 1-100)
